decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works hereby approved to the Ash Tree (T24), sited within the rear garden, and subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/24/8/70, must be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998:2010. 

To prevent unnecessary loss or mutilation to the tree, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 2 - No less than five working days' notice shall be given to the Council's Aboricultural Officer before any work commences on tree (Telephone 020 8748 3020). 

In order that the Council has the opportunity to ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with Condition 1, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: Pruning of an Ash Tree (T24) in the rear garden, subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/24/8/70.  The South-facing side has had a relatively recent crown reduction, while the  north-facing side has been left untreated, with the tree now being severely unbalanced.  It is proposed to reduce the north-facing side by reducing all stems by up to 4m to suitable growth points to re-balance and tidy; assess torn limb with large longitudinal scar on inbound side and remove if necessary.  All works are for routine maintenance.
